criteria.evidence: Read the diff. verifier.md line 13 adds "- records/, private files, and history are absent by design. Their absence is not a finding." This uses the same phrase as producer.md line 3 and reader.md line 3 ("records/, private files, and history are absent by design"), which I found with Grep.

criteria.criterion: verifier_brief in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs emits a sentence saying records/, the owner's private files, and history are absent by design and their absence is not a finding. Producer and reader briefs and prompts are unchanged.
criteria.evidence: briefs.rs line 378-379: the format string for "## The change" now ends with "records/, the owner's private files, and history are absent by design; their absence is not a finding." The diff touches no producer or reader brief code and does not change producer.md or reader.md.

criteria.criterion: A new unit test in briefs.rs asserts verifier_brief output contains the 'absent by design' statement naming records/ and private files. Run `cargo test -p athena-context` and see it pass.
criteria.evidence: The new test verifier_briefs_say_what_the_snapshot_lacks_is_not_a_finding asserts that brief.contains the full sentence. It passed, and the athena-context run passed 33 of 33. The sentence is new in this change, so the test would fail on the base.

criteria.evidence: Every test suite reported ok with 0 failed. My first clippy attempt failed only because I passed -q to clippy-driver by mistake; the corrected run finished clean with -D warnings.

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing the verifier statement.

findings.summary: Three existing lines of verifier.md were reworded without being asked for or explained.
findings.evidence: The diff changes "holds the repository at the candidate" to "holds the candidate", and "the brief's checks" to "the checks". The CHANGELOG does not mention these edits. They may have been made to keep the frame within its size budget, but I did not measure the budget, so that is a guess.

findings.summary: The new prompt line partly repeats the snapshot line just above it.
findings.evidence: Line 12 already says "no records/, no owner files, no history". Line 13 says it again and adds "absent by design... not a finding". Merging the two lines would be tighter.

summary: The change does what the retry asked. The verifier prompt now has a line saying "records/, private files, and history are absent by design. Their absence is not a finding." It is worded like producer.md and reader.md line 3. verifier_brief now emits a matching sentence in its "The change" section. Producer and reader prompts and briefs are unchanged. CHANGELOG.md has a Fixed entry that names the root cause. A new unit test, which would fail without the change, asserts the brief contains the sentence. I ran the new test, the athena-context tests, the workspace tests, clippy with -D warnings, and fmt --check, and all passed. All three changed files are on the deliverables list. One minor issue: the producer also reworded three existing lines of verifier.md that the request did not ask about, and nothing explains why.
